limitations: Headless Chromium only; no Owner acceptance and no exhaustive permutation certification
Static proof server (tools/serve.mjs) serves the current dist/ build only — no local runtime API process runs, so requestfailed transport entries are ENVIRONMENT noise, not product verdicts
Fixture rows and fixture admission/reviewer authority are labelled per flow; they are never presented as a real-consumer or a real achievement
Q-5 (Portfolio grouping authority) is an open Owner question: the portfolio flow proves the refusal, never an implementation

preconditions: static proof server serves the current dist/ build
no admission-authority registry ships with this route; the default product refusal is asserted first
flows.expectedState: Candidate import never implies verification or Admission; verification requires a bound verifier envelope; Admission requires validated intake AND explicit admission authority; the admitted Evidence is an immutable revision that creates no Review Decision and no Mastery
flows.fixtureState: reviewer harness seeds the candidate through the live evidence.import semantic command; the admission authority registry is injected ONLY after the default product refusal is captured, and is labelled FIXTURE in every receipt field
negativeCases: Admission before source verification must be refused with SOURCE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED
Admission without bound admission authority must be refused with ADMISSION_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE
Import must never report canonicalEvidenceCreated=true
Admission must not create a Review Decision or a Mastery mutation

consumerTaxonomy.primaryLiveOperationalConsumer: W04 Evidence domain executed inside the mounted Chromium page (CEPFoundation.m0Composition.group.evidence.domain)
consumerTaxonomy.recordedConsumer: m0 Evidence workbench DOM projection (rows, state list, import form)
consumerTaxonomy.fixture: candidate identity + admission authority registry injected by this harness (labelled FIXTURE)

actionSequence: GET /?surface=evidence
inspect the mounted Evidence workbench before any mutation
execute semantic command evidence.import (Candidate creation only)
NEGATIVE: attempt Admission before source verification
ATTTEST: bind a verifier envelope (verifySource) and record the attestation
submit for intake and validate intake
NEGATIVE: Admission without bound admission authority (product default)
bind an explicitly labelled FIXTURE admission authority and complete the lifecycle
re-render the workbench after Admission and capture the admitted state

preconditions: F-051 (Corr03 evidence-receipt overcount) is the regression under test: named count must never exceed unique identity count
receipts are counted by identity (sequence + command + subject), never by name alone
flows.expectedState: the W04 receipt census reports exactly one receipt per mutating operation, with unique receipt identities and a visible row count equal to the unique record id count; a refused operation emits no receipt
flows.fixtureState: three Candidates imported through the live evidence.import semantic command; one verified; one refused Admission (no receipt)
negativeCases: a refused Admission must not add a receipt (no phantom counts)
two receipts must never share an identity (sequence+command+subject)
the visible named row count must equal the unique record id count

consumerTaxonomy.primaryLiveOperationalConsumer: W04 Evidence domain receipt ledger executed inside the mounted Chromium page
consumerTaxonomy.recordedConsumer: m0 Evidence workbench collection rows (visible row census)
consumerTaxonomy.fixture: three Candidate identities imported by this harness

actionSequence: GET /?surface=evidence
import three Candidates through the live semantic command
verify one candidate (attestation receipt) and refuse one Admission (no receipt)
census the receipt ledger by identity

preconditions: no canonical Mastery writer / authorized evaluator is bound on this route
CEP-DEC-026 (A03) judgment + freshness vocabulary is the state machine under test
flows.expectedState: NOT_EVALUATED -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE/INCONCLUSIVE -> NOT_MASTERED/MASTERED with freshness CURRENT|REVALIDATION_REQUIRED; no progression may occur without a bound basis and an authorized evaluator; there is no local Mastery write
flows.fixtureState: reviewer harness injects ONE synthetic Mastery State row (truthClass SYNTHETIC_DEMO_SEED) so the state machine has a subject; the row is labelled fixture and is never presented as a real achievement
negativeCases: reevaluation without an authorized evaluator must be refused (AUTHORIZED_EVALUATOR_UNBOUND)
reevaluation with an unavailable basis must be refused (BASIS_UNAVAILABLE)
conflicting Decisions must route to governed evaluation, never to a grant (CONFLICT_REQUIRES_GOVERNED_EVALUATION)
local freshness/Mastery writes must be refused (CANONICAL_MASTERY_WRITE_FORBIDDEN)
completion/activity must never be an input to Mastery

consumerTaxonomy.primaryLiveOperationalConsumer: W04 Mastery domain executed inside the mounted Chromium page
consumerTaxonomy.recordedConsumer: m0 Mastery workbench DOM projection (rows, explainability projection)
consumerTaxonomy.fixture: single SYNTHETIC_DEMO_SEED Mastery State injected by this harness

actionSequence: GET /?surface=mastery
inspect the mounted Mastery workbench before any mutation
inject ONE synthetic Mastery State (truthClass SYNTHETIC_DEMO_SEED) as the state-machine subject
NEGATIVE: re-evaluation with an unavailable/unbound basis
NEGATIVE: basis bound but no authorized evaluator -> no grant
NEGATIVE: conflicting Decisions route to governed evaluation, never to a grant
NEGATIVE: local freshness write is forbidden (canonical Mastery writer only)
explain the causal basis and confirm completion/activity is never an input

preconditions: Portfolio owns curation references only; the shared source resolver can only resolve admitted Evidence/ Mastery revisions
Project/Learning Objective grouping authority is UNRESOLVED (open question Q-5) — no grouping registry is bound
flows.expectedState: assembly adds reference-only memberships whose source state is whatever the resolver observed (never an invented RESOLVABLE); grouping is refused with AUTHORITY_DECISION_REQUIRED while Q-5 is open; export is a reproducible projection that never duplicates or deletes canonical truth
flows.fixtureState: reviewer harness adds two curation references through the live portfolio.curate path; the referenced sources do not exist, so their source state must stay UNVERIFIED_PROVIDER_UNBOUND
negativeCases: grouping without bound authority must be refused with AUTHORITY_DECISION_REQUIRED (Q-5 stays open)
a missing canonical source must never be presented as RESOLVABLE
curate remove must preserve the canonical source (canonicalSourceWrite=false, sourcePreserved=true)
export must never claim canonical publication or copy canonical Evidence truth

consumerTaxonomy.primaryLiveOperationalConsumer: W04 Portfolio domain executed inside the mounted Chromium page
consumerTaxonomy.recordedConsumer: m0 Portfolio workbench DOM projection (rows, curation metadata)
consumerTaxonomy.fixture: two curation references added by this harness

actionSequence: GET /?surface=portfolio
inspect the mounted Portfolio workbench before any mutation
assemble a curation reference whose canonical source is NOT resolvable
NEGATIVE: grouping without bound authority (open question Q-5)
add a second reference, then remove the first with an exact revision envelope
export twice and compare byte-for-byte (reproducible export)

preconditions: shared W04 evidence domain starts empty, so no admitted immutable Evidence exists yet
central ReviewAuthorityRegistry is bound (no reviewer is registered initially)
flows.expectedState: a Review cannot exist without pinned admitted immutable Evidence; workflow runs REQUESTED -> ASSIGNED -> IN_REVIEW -> finding -> READY_FOR_DECISION -> CLOSED verdict; the Decision is append-only immutable lineage; the family never self-admits and never claims formal presentation authority
flows.fixtureState: reviewer harness (a) seeds the shared Evidence domain through the live evidence API with a labelled FIXTURE admission authority, (b) registers ONE reviewer in the CENTRAL ReviewAuthorityRegistry. Both are labelled fixture; no review, finding or Decision content is invented by the harness beyond the explicit reviewer-authored text used by this proof.
negativeCases: a Review request pinned to a non-existent Evidence revision must be refused (ADMITTED_IMMUTABLE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED)
a finding/Decision must never be created without reviewer authority
a second Decision must not overwrite or delete the first (append-only lineage)
the family must stay familyAdmissionClaim=false and CONCEPT_CONTRACT_ONLY (no self-approval)

consumerTaxonomy.primaryLiveOperationalConsumer: W04 Review domain + central ReviewAuthorityRegistry executed inside the mounted Chromium page
consumerTaxonomy.recordedConsumer: m0 Reviews workbench DOM projection (rows, governed Review input form)
consumerTaxonomy.fixture: reviewer registration + admission authority injected by this harness (labelled FIXTURE)

actionSequence: GET /?surface=reviews
inspect the mounted Reviews workbench before any mutation
NEGATIVE: request a Review pinned to an Evidence revision that does not exist
seed the shared Evidence domain through the live evidence domain API (labelled FIXTURE) so a real admitted revision can be pinned
register exactly one Reviewer in the CENTRAL ReviewAuthorityRegistry (the only authority path)
request the formal Review pinned to the admitted Evidence revision + pinned criterion
assign -> start the Review
record an explicit reviewer-authored finding (no manufactured text)
mark ready for Decision
record the verdict (issuing Decision) with explicit expected CAS = null (no prior Decision)
NEGATIVE: re-issuing a Decision on a CLOSED review must not mutate lineage
assert the family authority ceiling after the verdict
